description: A ground-level photograph captures a serene landscape featuring a broad expanse of calm, brownish-tinted water under a light blue sky with scattered white cumulus clouds. Numerous small, light-coloured boats are visible, widely distributed across the water surface. Along the distant horizon, a low, dark green line of land, possibly vegetated with trees, is discernible. This image represents a typical coastal lagoon or estuary environment, aligning with CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 8.3.1 Lagoons or 8.3.2 Estuaries, and is consistent with descriptions of locations like the Ria Formosa in Portugal.
